current_claim: A static local-first evidence surface preserving a completed handoff, bounded scenario result, source identities, conflicts, and prospective qualification plans without retrospective regrading.
mechanism: The application separates transaction completion, bounded test result, source force, conflict, and prospective plan while recognizing known private source identities locally and preserving public and private export boundaries.

findings.title: The known private source pair is recognized by hash without an independently replayable private qualification package.
findings.mechanism: The public release can identify the exact private inputs and reconstruct their cartridge locally, but a successor without those authorized bytes cannot independently exercise the complete recognition and reconstruction path.
findings.acceptance: Retain an authorized private replay receipt or a cryptographic synthetic twin that exercises the identical recognition, parsing, conflict, and export mechanisms without publishing private content.

findings.title: Unsupported formats are admitted, but the intake boundary lacks a hostile and malformed file corpus.
findings.mechanism: Office, PDF, image, archive, HTML, and binary objects may remain source-bound while oversized files, duplicate identities, deceptive extensions, nested archives, parser faults, and active content still threaten custody and usability.
findings.acceptance: Exercise malformed documents, archives, inert HTML, oversized files, duplicates, misleading extensions, unsupported binaries, and resource ceilings with retained refusal receipts.

findings.title: The constitutional evidence is stronger than the visual, role, and successor qualification.
findings.mechanism: A content-addressed one-file application can preserve its law while compact layouts, keyboard order, touch behavior, visual hierarchy, public-private export cues, or role-specific use regress.
findings.acceptance: Add role walkthroughs, desktop and mobile goldens, keyboard and touch evidence, and cold-successor replay for public and authorized private bundles.

assets_required: authorized replay receipt or cryptographic synthetic twin
public and private successor replay packages
next_gate: Prove exact intake and reconstruction under hostile files and a cold successor without changing the earlier receipt.
